Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 5, 2026

Note: this is a draft document, describing what our systems actually do, as detailed below. It does not constitute legal advice. Before the site goes live, this document should be reviewed by someone qualified (a lawyer / GDPR consultant).

1. Who we are

Adaptive Technologies is the controller of the personal data collected through this website and the RAG demo described below. We are a Romanian company based in Bucharest, Romania. For any question about your data, you can write to us at any time at contact@adaptivetech.ro.

2. What data we collect

2.1 The contact form

The contact form on this site collects your name, company (optional), email address, area of interest, and a message (optional). This data is never sent to any server of ours: on submit, the form opens your own email client (a mailto: link) with the fields pre-filled, and the message is sent directly from your own email address to contact@adaptivetech.ro.

2.2 The RAG demo

As of this document, the RAG demo is not yet publicly available — the section below describes what happens to your data once it launches.

The demo collects: your email address (verified with a 6-digit code), the content of the document you upload, the questions you ask about that document, and your IP address.

3. Who we share data with

To function, our systems send part of your data to the following providers, each with a clearly defined role:

  • Google (Gemini) — extracts text from the document you upload, generates the vector embeddings used for search, and generates the answers you receive in the conversation, based on the relevant fragments of your document. Your document's content is sent to Google for these purposes.
  • Cloudflare — verifies through Turnstile that you're a real person rather than an automated script, and provides the CDN/proxy infrastructure the site's traffic passes through.
  • Supabase — hosts the database that temporarily stores documents, extracted chunks, and the questions asked.
  • Hetzner — hosts the servers the application runs on.

To be explicit, because it matters before you upload anything: the content of the document you upload is sent to Google for processing. Please don't upload a document you wouldn't want shared with that provider — for example, a contract containing highly sensitive information.

4. How long we keep data

  • Uploaded documents and the chunks extracted from them are deleted automatically when the session expires, 2 hours after upload. The actual purge job runs once an hour, so in practice a document can remain stored for up to 3 hours.
  • Questions asked in the demo are kept for 30 days, fully detached from the session — they can no longer be linked back to the document or to you after the window above.
  • Your email address and interaction counts are kept until you unsubscribe. Every code email includes a signed unsubscribe link, usable at any time.

5. Legal basis

The legal basis for processing your data is consent, given by checking the agreement box on the form or in the demo. You can withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal.

6. Your rights

Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to:

  • Access — to find out what data we hold about you.
  • Rectification — to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
  • Erasure — to request deletion of your data (the "right to be forgotten").
  • Portability — to receive your data in a structured, usable format.
  • Objection — to object to the processing of your data.
  • Withdrawal of consent — at any time, with no retroactive effect.

To exercise any of these rights, write to us at contact@adaptivetech.ro. We will respond within the timeframe required by law.
